[attribute-term-status]
=== `@term-status` Term Status

The current status of a term (<<element-term,`<term>`>> inside a <<element-term-display,`<term-display>`>>) in a terms and definitions section, for example, “`deprecated`”.

#### Usage/Remarks
The current <<attribute-term-status,`@term-status`>> values are from a TBX list of term statuses.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-term,`<term>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| admitted| A term that does not meet the requirements to be a preferred term, but is not deprecated,
                        possibly because it is in common use. Expanded and abbreviated forms of a term are
                        sometimes used as admitted terms.
| non-preferred| This term is deprecated in favor of a preferred term. 
                        Deprecated terms include obsolete and superseded terms.
| preferred| This term is the one to be used.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===

#### Tagged Sample

##### Preferred term
[source,xml]
....
...
<term-display>
 <term term-status="preferred">Kapselung</term>
 <term-display-string>(en: <term xml:lang="en" 
   term-type="translation">enclosure</term>)</term-display-string>
 <def>
  <p>Teil einer gasisolierten, metallgekapselten Schaltanlage, ...</p>
 </def>
</term-display>
...
....
